title: Hizli arama
purpose: HomeSearchScreen. Search bar tap from dashboard opens this screen with auto-focused input. Quick-filter chips (Yolculuk/Atolye/Modul/e-Kitap). Submit navigates to HomeSearchResults with query + filter params (AC-FR-E2-05-01). Results categorized by type (AC-FR-E2-05-02). No-results state shows Discover suggestion (AC-FR-E2-05-03).

loading.description: Input auto-focused on mount. Skeleton shown for recent searches and popular topics sections.

ready.description: Search input with auto-focus, 4 quick-filter chips (single-select), recent search chips (Temizle action), popular topics cards. Ara button enabled when query non-empty. AC-FR-E2-05-01 satisfied.

empty.description: No recent searches: recent search section hidden. Popular topics still visible as discovery aid.

error.description: 'Arama yuklenemedi. Tekrar Dene' with back navigation still active.

offline.description: Input disabled with 'Arama cevrimdisi desteklenmez' notice. Recent searches visible from cache. Popular topics from cache.
